name: PALE DOMINION: Neural Grand Strategy
subcategory: competitive esports / grand strategy neural sim
description: PALE DOMINION is an asynchronous grand strategy title where players manage fictional corponations across a 200-year simulated timeline, with BCI integration allowing direct neural investment in the emotional states of their simulated workforce and executive class. OmniPath Biotech published it as a prestige Tier 4-5 product, but its strategic depth attracted a devoted Tier 3 following who play on subsidized licenses. The game's AI opponents are disturbingly good — several Tier 4 corporate strategists have admitted their real-world decisions have been influenced by PALE DOMINION scenarios, which is either a feature or a horror depending on your perspective.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 PALE DOMINION player makes a move in a competitive match that mirrors, exactly, a real OmniPath Biotech acquisition strategy that hasn't been announced yet.
The game's AI opponents have begun making moves that no human player or developer can explain — and the lead AI architect has gone quiet.
A labor organizer discovers that the 'simulated workforce' emotional states in PALE DOMINION are based on anonymized real BCI data harvested from OmniPath employees.
